resources.string: Create an offline chart with one documented historical rule set. This is a cultural belief system, not a scientific prediction.
Delete %1$s from this device? You can recreate the chart from the birth details.
Use a nickname or leave the name blank. Birth details stay in the app’s private database on this device.
The historical male/female parameter determines the direction of major and minor cycles in the selected source.
Convert the birth time to fixed UTC+7 before entering it. Birthplace, historical time standards and true solar time are not adjusted.
Both 23:00 and 00:00 belong to the Tý hour. Choose whether 23:00 starts the next day or keeps the civil date. This choice is saved with the profile.
The corresponding solar date must be between 1 Jan 1900 and 31 Dec 2100. Lunar dates and leap months must exist.
The date, time or leap month is invalid or outside the supported range. Check the fields.
The operation could not be completed. Please try again.
%1$s bureau · first major cycle at counted age %2$d
Zi Wei Dou Shu Quan Shu · Ming Nanyangtang edition, volume 3
Tap a palace for details. Pinch to zoom and drag to pan. List mode keeps the text easy to read.
Each palace has a ten-year age range determined by the bureau’s start age and cycle direction. This is a calculated placement, without a prediction of events.
This age is before the bureau’s first major cycle.
Enter a traditional counted age from 1 to 120. Age is not inferred from today’s date.
Traditional topic: %1$s. Palace names describe topics in the historical system; this app does not infer life outcomes from the stars placed here.
The Ming rows are preserved: Geng uses Thái Dương/Vũ Khúc/Thiên Đồng/Thiên Tướng; Ren uses Thiên Lương/Tử Vi/Thiên Phủ/Vũ Khúc. Other schools may differ.
One of fourteen main stars. Positions come from the bureau/lunar-day table for Tử Vi and the relative placements of the Tử Vi–Thiên Phủ groups. Source: 定金木水火土局, 安南北斗諸星訣, 安天府圖.
A member of the Văn Xương–Văn Khúc pair, placed by birth hour in this edition. Source: 安文昌文曲星訣.
A member of the Tả Phụ–Hữu Bật pair, placed by regular birth month. The selected text does not settle leap-month placement, so it is omitted. Source: 安左輔右弼星訣.
Lộc Tồn is placed by birth-year stem. Kình Dương and Đà La occupy the adjacent palaces according to the rule. Source: 安祿存星訣, 安擎羊陀羅二星訣.
Thiên Mã is placed by the birth-year branch group. Source: 安天馬星訣.
This edition calls the star counted backward from Hợi by birth hour Thiên Không (天空); the forward-counted star is Địa Kiếp. Names differ between schools. Source: 安天空地劫訣.

Includes Life/Body, bureau, 14 main stars, up to 10 auxiliary stars, four transformations, and major/minor cycles. Star strength, other auxiliaries and predictions are unsupported. Two Tử Vi table cells (wood 3/day 5 and metal 4/day 30) use documented editorial corrections.

Leap-month profile: Life/Body use the following numbered month in this edition. Tả Phụ/Hữu Bật are omitted because their leap rule is not established; a transformation targeting either has no invented location.
Ming edition record · National Archives of Japan
Compares supported calendar facts and placements. No compatibility score or relationship prediction is generated.
Save at least two profiles to compare them.
The file includes the selected profile’s name or nickname, birth date and time, historical sex parameter, chart conventions and results. Continue only if you agree to save or share these details.
Cultural reference; not a scientific prediction. Fixed UTC+7. Results depend on the 23:00 convention and the stated rule set.
